assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation
the intermittent nature of these symptoms
the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period
mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
capture arrhythmic events and guide further management
This service is medically necessary to document the intermittent arrhythmias described in the clinical indication
support the diagnosis of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and atrial fibrillation
